snippet.title: Cursebreakers | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Cursebeakers ⚔️🔥

Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Master sword & sorcery together, explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and BREAK THE CURSE!

🔗 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234640/Cursebreakers/
🌍 Who we are: https://www.falsewall.at/
